description: Statically derived by reading app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl, never captured from a run: the COBOL cannot be executed in this environment. This is the menu-driven twin of case01 - EIBCALEN is NOT zero, so the first limb of the guard at :388-390 is false and it is the SECOND limb, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM EQUAL LIT-MENUPGM AND NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER, that admits it. The limb depends on the commarea's own fields and on nothing else, which is why the byte count stated here is the complete 489: :388 tests EIBCALEN against zero and against nothing else, and every other use of the passed area reads exactly DFHCOMMAREA(1:160) and DFHCOMMAREA(161:329), so the translation reports the length as absent or complete rather than reproducing a terminal-dependent count the program never examines. COMEN01C's XCTL passes CARDDEMO-COMMAREA alone, which is exactly why this limb has to exist at all - without it the ELSE at :396-400 would read past the end of a menu-sized area - and the limb being reached is what this case pins. COMEN01C.cbl:147-154 is the caller and fixes every inbound value: MOVE WS-TRANID TO CDEMO-FROM-TRANID gives CM00, MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM gives COMEN01C, MOVE ZEROS TO CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT gives 0, and the XCTL passes COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA) - 160 bytes, which is why this limb has to exist at all: the ELSE at :396-400 reads DFHCOMMAREA(1:160) and then (161:329) for the 329-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, and on a 160-byte area that second read runs off the end. The remaining inbound fields are the residue of a real session, each traceable: CDEMO-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-TYPE from COSGN00C.cbl:226-227, and CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-CARD-NUM, CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET and CDEMO-LAST-MAP from the PF03 arm of COCRDLIC.cbl:384-405 (:390-392) - the user browsed the card list, went back to the menu, and picked Card Update. The redundant-condition finding this case exists for, and the reason it matters to gate G30: the very condition at :389-390 appears a second time as the second WHEN of the third EVALUATE arm at :504-505, and yet arm three is NOT reached through it. :391-394 fire first - INITIALIZE CARDDEMO-COMMAREA WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, SET CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, SET CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED - and INITIALIZE has already erased CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM to spaces by the time the ordered EVALUATE TRUE at :429 runs, so :504-505 can no longer be true while its restated predicate is exactly what got us here; instead the FIRST WHEN at :502-503, CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED AND CDEMO-PGM-ENTER, matches on the flags :393-394 just set. An implementation that reordered the two WHENs, or that treated :504-505 as the live test, would take a different route to the same screen and this case would still pass - which is why the observable outcome is pinned instead: arm one at :435-439 cannot match an ENTER AID with CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION at LOW-VALUES, and arm two at :482-485 cannot match because :391 left CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM spaces rather than LIT-CCLISTPGM. The critical consequence of :391 is that every inbound commarea field is discarded, so the navigation asserted below is byte-identical to case01's even though the caller supplied nine non-blank values: CDEMO-ACCT-ID comes back 00000000000 and CDEMO-CARD-NUM 0000000000000000 although 00000000050 and 0500024453765740 - row 1 of fixtures/carddata.txt - arrived in them, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM comes back spaces although COMEN01C arrived in it, the signed-on CDEMO-USER-ID and CDEMO-USER-TYPE are lost, and CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET and CDEMO-LAST-MAP are wiped from COCRDLI and CCRDLIA to spaces. INITIALIZE takes each elementary item to its category default - spaces for PIC X, zeros for PIC 9 - and app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy declares no data-item VALUE clause for it to reinstate, its only four VALUE clauses being the 88-level condition names at :27-28 and :30-31, so the 160 bytes are genuinely blank. That is real, easily-missed behaviour and it is encoded rather than tidied: a translation that copied the commarea through whenever EIBCALEN was non-zero would echo COMEN01C and the card key straight back and fail here alone. The AID survives the coercion at :413-424 untouched - CSSTRPFY, copied at :1528, maps DFHENTER onto CCARD-AID-ENTER, which is one of the four the :414-418 test accepts, so PFK-VALID holds and :423 never rewrites it. Arm three's body is :506-511: INITIALIZE WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA, then the single-line range-perform PERFORM 3000-SEND-MAP THRU 3000-SEND-MAP-EXIT at :507-508 - one of only two such sites in the program, the other being :524 - then SET CDEMO-PGM-REENTER at :509, SET CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :510 and GO TO COMMON-RETURN at :511, whose EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID(LIT-THISTRANID) COMMAREA(WS-COMMAREA) at :554-558 is the RETURN_TRANSID termination. Every sent value is read from source at the width app/cpy-bms/COCRDUP.CPY declares for its xxxI item (4/40/8/8/40/8/11/16/50/1/2/4/2/40/80/21/18): 3100 fills CCRDUPAO with LOW-VALUES at :1053 before moving the two active COTTL01Y titles - line 21 of app/cpy/COTTL01Y.cpy is commented out, so CCDA-TITLE02 is the CardDemo literal on the active line 22 - plus LIT-THISTRANID, LIT-THISPGM and the MM/DD/YY and HH:MM:SS renderings that app/cpy/CSDAT01Y.cpy:30-41 lays out, taken from the pinned clock so the header is reproducible rather than wall-clock dependent. 3200 is the secondary target: it opens IF CDEMO-PGM-ENTER CONTINUE at :1084-1085, and because :393 left that condition true the whole ELSE is skipped and the seven data items keep 3100's LOW-VALUES. The skipped limb is worth naming because of what it reads - IF CC-ACCT-ID-N = 0 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO ACCTSIDO at :1087-1091 and IF CC-CARD-NUM-N = 0 MOVE LOW-VALUES TO CARDSIDO at :1093-1097 both test the numeric REDEFINES views CC-ACCT-ID-N PIC 9(11) and CC-CARD-NUM-N PIC 9(16) laid over the alphanumeric CC-ACCT-ID PIC X(11) and CC-CARD-NUM PIC X(16) spans of app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy:34-39, two typed accessors over one backing span, which is gate G34; that copybook declares three such pairs and not one, the third being CC-CUST-ID PIC X(09) over CC-CUST-ID-N PIC 9(9) at :40-42, and round-tripping it is left to case20. 3250's first arm at :1141 supplies the X(40) prompt from WS-INFO-MSG, and ERRMSGO stays blank at its X(80) width because WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) was set OFF at :384 and nothing on this path wrote to it - no thank-you and no invalid-key literal appears, because CSMSG01Y's CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU and CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY have zero references in this program and only CCDA-TITLE01 and CCDA-TITLE02 at :1057-1058 are used. This is the ENTER half of gate G38: nothing is marked with an asterisk and nothing is reddened. COCRDUPC does not copy CSSETATY at all; its highlight logic is inline at :1243-1307, where AND CDEMO-PGM-REENTER guards ACCTSID at :1248 and CARDSID at :1258 and AND CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK guards the four data fields from :1264 onward, and every one of those guards is false here. The colour override at :1238-1241 is false too, since :391 left CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET spaces rather than LIT-CCLISTMAPSET, so ACCTSIDC and CARDSIDC keep the X'00' that IS DFHDFCOL; only EXPDAYC differs, from the unconditional MOVE DFHBMDAR at :1285. 3300's protection matrix at :1172-1208 takes its first arm, WHEN CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, moving DFHBMFSE into ACCTSIDA and CARDSIDA and DFHBMPRF into CRDNAMEA, CRDSTCDA, EXPMONA and EXPYEARA, with EXPDAYA commented out at :1178 and therefore left unset; those six items are recorded here rather than asserted below because they are xxxA items of CCRDUPAI, and since CCRDUPAO REDEFINES CCRDUPAI each xxxA byte falls inside the output group's FILLER PIC X(3) - a different byte from the xxxC colour item - so no symbolic-map output name addresses it. The cursor is reached through :1215-1217 rather than the WHEN OTHER at :1234: :375 INITIALIZE WS-MISC-STORAGE leaves WS-EDIT-ACCT-FLAG a space, so FLG-ACCTFILTER-BLANK is true and MOVE -1 TO ACCTSIDL positions the cursor on a field this path never edited. FKEYSO and FKEYSCO stay LOW-VALUES because the program never writes them - their text is a physical-map INITIAL at app/bms/COCRDUP.bms:162 and :167 that CICS merges at send time. Gate G37 is satisfied structurally: the whole conversation state travels in the payload, the 160-byte CARDDEMO-COMMAREA as common/NavigationContext and the 329-byte WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA as 1 + 89 + 89 + 150, and nothing is held server-side; post-call CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT is 1 from :509 and CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION is back in its CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED state, whose 88 at :278-280 covers both LOW-VALUES and SPACES. The unit is reached as a plain object - card.CardUpdateController constructed and its handler called directly, with no MockMvc, no servlet container and no JobLauncher in the path, which is gate G51. Nothing is written on this path and no dataset is even read, so expectedWrites, expectedFinalState and expectedDatasets are all empty by design rather than by omission - each is a positive assertion that the channel produced nothing. CARDDAT is seeded from the first three rows of fixtures/carddata.txt at the 150-byte CVACT02Y width purely so the repository the handler is wired to has a real backing store; the fixture is already full width, so no normalisation is declared. There is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' anywhere in COCRDUPC - it installs EXEC CICS HANDLE ABEND at :370-372 instead - so the return code is 0 and gate G35 does not apply here, just as G32 does not (all 21 GO TOs in this program are forward) and G39 does not (this screen paginates nothing).
